quote: Logistics Center launch: A $30 million investment in infrastructure and systems will see the launch of a new Logistics Center in Monterrey, along with a Warehouse Management System. This investment aims to support Cummins' growing needs in North America.
note: Opened Cummins Inc. company news 3 Oct 2024 (CDBS ProductionNEXT). Distinct from USD 33m Monterrey ADB capacity CapEx on same release.
